selection_source: Search-only CV, five-fold rechecks and repeated-seed stability. No calibration or confirmation scores used to choose ranges.

suggestions.training_device_note: Use CPU for tree ensembles. A GPU is not needed for this small dataset; XGBoost may be trained with device=cpu without changing the parameter grid.

evaluation_note: Keep informative duplicate groups together in CV. Fit preprocessing inside each fold. Reserve separate data for threshold calibration and final testing.
threshold_note: After training on AWS, choose a new threshold on the separate calibration set. Do not copy the old model's threshold onto a newly fitted model.
scope_note: Reproduce the exact selected configuration before trying an optional small grid. More search is not required by these local results.
